entries.title: What's new — we ship in public
entries.summary: This page lists every user-facing feature as it lands. Returning visitors also get a small popup with updates since their last visit.

entries.title: More episodes from the same show
entries.summary: After a transcript finishes, pick another episode from that podcast in one click, or follow the show so it shows up in Feeds.

entries.title: Keep your episode through signup
entries.summary: Sign up with the episode you already chose, see how many free minutes you have left, and buy more without leaving the page.

entries.title: Pricing page and minutes in the nav
entries.summary: A clear Pricing page explains the free trial, credit pack, and bring-your-own-key options. Signed-in users see remaining minutes in the header.

entries.title: Buy five hours of audio for $5
entries.summary: When the free trial runs out, buy a one-time credit pack — no subscription. Credits do not expire.

entries.title: Three free hours to start
entries.summary: New accounts get a generous free trial on our OpenAI key — no card and no key of your own required to try Podskrift.

entries.title: HTTP API for scripts and agents
entries.summary: Create an API key in Settings and resolve, transcribe, and fetch transcripts over HTTP. Same free trial as the web app.

entries.title: Paste a Spotify link
entries.summary: Drop an open.spotify.com episode or show link into search and go straight to transcription when the show has a public feed.

entries.title: Search inside your transcripts
entries.summary: On History, search the full text of your completed transcripts and jump to a highlighted snippet.

entries.title: Live job bar on every page
entries.summary: A transcription keeps running when you navigate away. A small bar on every page shows progress so you can return to it.

entries.title: Stop a job, or pick it up later
entries.summary: Cancel a running transcription when you change your mind. Leave and come back — unfinished jobs are listed on the home page with live progress.

entries.title: Free trial on our OpenAI key
entries.summary: Try Podskrift without pasting an API key. Usage is metered per account so the shared trial stays available for everyone.

entries.title: Episode search, language picker, live progress
entries.summary: Search individual episode titles, choose the spoken language (or auto-detect), and watch a smooth progress bar with ETA while Whisper works.

entries.title: Accounts, saved feeds, and your own key
entries.summary: Create an account, save podcast feeds you use often, search the catalogue by show name, or bring your own OpenAI key and pay Whisper directly.

entries.title: Copy transcript and cost estimates
entries.summary: Copy a finished transcript in one click. History shows estimated Whisper cost per episode and a running total.

entries.title: Apple Podcasts URL to RSS
entries.summary: Paste an Apple Podcasts show link and Podskrift finds the underlying RSS feed so you can pick an episode.
